Functions
cpct_drawPlotM1

Draws a single pixel on screen in Mode 1 (320x200, 4 colors) at specified coordinates using lookup tables for masks and pixel color patterns.

C Definition

void cpct_drawPlotM1(u8* screen_start, u16 x, u8 y, u8 color) __z88dk_callee;

Input Parameters
(2B DE) screen_start

Base VRAM memory address (typically 0xC000)

(2B HL) x

X coordinate in pixels (0-319)

(1B C)  y

Y coordinate in pixels (0-199)

(1B B)  color

Pen color index (0-3)

Assembly call:

call cpct_drawPlotM1_asm

Requirements and limitations:

  • Coordinates must stay within Mode 1 screen bounds (X: 0-319, Y: 0-199).

  • Requires `cpct_plotColorTable_M1`, and `cpct_plotMasksTable_M1` to be defined globally.

Destroyed Register values: AF, BC, DE, HL

Required memory: ASM routine - 58 bytes C routine - 62 bytes (+20 bytes for required tables)
